# Four variations, four API calls

**Workflow:** [`flux2/flux2-variations.json`](../flux2/flux2-variations.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux2` |
| Nodes | 10 |
| Links | 8 |
| Paid API calls per run | **4** |

---

Four takes on one image at fixed seeds, so the set is reproducible and you can tell which seed gave you which result.

Every run bills **four** generations. Delete a branch to spend less; copy one to spend more.

The four nodes are identical apart from `seed` (1001–1004, all `fixed`), so the set is reproducible — same seeds, same four images. Set a seed to **-1** for a fresh random one on each run.

`disable_pup` is **off** on purpose. FLUX.2 [pro] upsamples the prompt by default and rewrites it differently on each call, which widens the spread. Turn it **on** for tighter variations that differ mostly by seed.

Each branch writes its own filename prefix so the outputs stay tellable apart on disk. Save Image previews inside the node, so there is no separate Preview node here.

### Dialling the spread
- **Narrow** — name what must not change: *"same subject, same composition, same palette"*.
- **Wide** — ask for the change: *"same subject, different time of day and camera angle"*.
